benefits.title: 10 Powerful Benefits
benefits.subtitle: Discover how LandVal is revolutionizing Rwanda's land market with official data, advanced technology, and unmatched support

benefits.benefit1Desc: Direct integration with Rwanda Land Authority's official gazette data, updated quarterly for maximum accuracy.
benefits.benefit2Desc: Get accurate property prices in under 30 seconds using advanced algorithms and real-time market data.
benefits.benefit3Desc: Connect with 500,000+ Rwandans abroad and international investors seeking Rwandan real estate.
